english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the punctuation mark used at the end of a sentence.
Use this specifically for a sentence-ending full stop or period, not for a dot in an address.
Use this for the full-stop punctuation mark at the end of a sentence or in an abbreviation.

examples.english: Add a full stop at the end of this sentence, otherwise it won't be complete.
examples.traditional: 呢句句尾要加句號，唔係就唔完整。
examples.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 geoi3 mei5 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6 m4 hai6 zau6 m4 jyun4 zing2

examples.english: Put a dot at the end of this sentence.
examples.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6

examples.english: This English sentence needs a period at the end.
examples.traditional: 呢句英文最後要加句號。
examples.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 jing1 man4 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6
